LAB 01 · FEB 16 2026
Panel Layout & Bill of Materials
UG + Grad

Reverse-engineered the Wright State PLC training station. Wired an NPN inductive proximity sensor to the CompactLogix PLC, developed motor/light control logic based on sensor signals, and created a full BOM and physical panel layout sketch.

Seal-in circuitNPN sensor wiringXIC / XIO contactsBOM creationPanel layout
Result: Motor + green light on start; amber replaces both on proximity trigger; red on stop. All outputs validated online.

LAB 02 · FEB 28 2026
Output Latch & Unlatch Introduction
UG + Grad

Strict push-button sequencing using OTL/OTU instructions. Only one light can be ON at any time. Three sequences: Black→(Green/Red) lights green, Green→(Black/Red) lights yellow, Red→(Green/Black) lights red. Reset via simultaneous Black+Green or proximity sensor toggle.

// inputs
BLACK_PB · I.DATA.3GREEN_PB · I.DATA.2RED_PB · I.DATA.1PROX · I.DATA.8
// outputs
GREEN_LIGHT · O.DATA.2YELLOW_LIGHT · O.DATA.1RED_LIGHT · O.DATA.0
OTL / OTU instructionsSequential interlockingXOR reset logicMemory bitsMutual exclusion
Result: All three sequences verified. Global reset clears all latches via simultaneous press or proximity toggle.

LAB 03 · MAR 9 2026
Motor Control & Timer Introduction
UG + Grad

PLC-based motor control with Run, Stop, and Emergency Stop. Two versions: UG (5 s auto-stop via T1) and Graduate (3 s amber delay before 5 s motor run using cascaded T1→T2). Stop/E-Stop immediately kills motor and lights red at any point.

// inputs
STOP_PB · I.DATA.1START_PB · I.DATA.2E.STOP · I.DATA.3
// outputs + timers
MOTOR · O.DATA.8GREEN · O.DATA.2AMBER · O.DATA.1RED · O.DATA.0T1 · 3000msT2 · 5000ms
TON timerCascaded timersE-Stop logic3-wire circuitTimed output window
Result: Motor runs exactly 5 s after 3 s amber delay. Stop/E-Stop verified at any point. Auto-stop via T2.DN confirmed.

LAB 04 · MAR 24 2026
Garage Door Control System
UG + Grad

Single-button ON/OFF garage door with 6 s travel time. Proximity sensor reverses to UP immediately. Graduate: pause mid-travel, capture T1.ACC via MOV into T3.PRE (TOF), reverse for exact elapsed time. Right red flashes at 0.5 Hz when paused.

GREEN_PB · I.DATA.2PROXIMITY · I.DATA.14
// outputs + internals

ONS instructionFlip-flop toggleMOV instructionTOF timer0.5 Hz flashState machine
Result: Door cycles UP↔DOWN. Prox forces UP. Graduate pause-and-reverse verified — T1.ACC used as T3 preset for exact partial travel.

LAB 05 · MAR 23 2026
Modified Conveyor Belt Control
UG + Grad

Conveyor with 10 s timed operation (Timer Mode) and indefinite continuous operation (Run Mode). Right green flashes at 2 Hz in Timer Mode. Graduate: Black PB toggles modes; Run Mode lights left amber and alternates right green/amber at 2 Hz using paired 500 ms timers.

// inputs
GREEN_PB · I.DATA.2BLACK_PB · I.DATA.3
// outputs + timers
L-GREEN · O.DATA.2L-RED · O.DATA.0L-AMBER · O.DATA.1R-GREEN · O.DATA.5R-AMBER · O.DATA.4T1 · 10000msT2/T3/T4/T5 · 500ms
Mode toggleComplementary timers2 Hz flashAuto-stop timerONS + seal-in
Result: Timer mode auto-stops at 10 s with 2 Hz flash. Black PB toggles Run Mode with amber + alternating amber/green flash. Both modes verified.

LAB 06 · APR 3 2026
Two-Direction Traffic Light System
UG + Grad

Bi-directional intersection for ACME Widget Co. 9 s init (both reds), then alternating 9 s green → 6 s amber → 3 s all-red per direction. GEQ triggers early green→amber if T2.ACC ≥ 5000 ms. Graduate: Black PB 3-press override with 1 s flashing using ≤6 total timers.

// inputs
GREEN_PB · I.DATA.2BLACK_PB · I.DATA.3PROXIMITY · I.DATA.15
// outputs
L-RED · O.DATA.0L-AMBER · O.DATA.1L-GREEN · O.DATA.2R-RED · O.DATA.3R-AMBER · O.DATA.4R-GREEN · O.DATA.5
GEQ comparisonOTL / OTU latchFlip-flop direction3-press overrideT5/T6 oscillator6-timer constraint
Result: Full 36 s cycle verified. Proximity interrupt tested at >5 s green. Graduate amber-flash and green-flash overrides correct.

LAB 08 · APR 20 2026
Sequential Taillight Control System
UG + Grad

Automotive-style taillight sequencer using SQO instructions. Left (Green PB) and right (Black PB) step Green→Green+Amber→All ON→All OFF at 2 s intervals. Proximity toggles hazard: both reds flash at ≈2 Hz via T2.ACC bit-10 examination. Graduate: side-switching, toggle-off, ≤2 timers and ≤2 sequencers.

// inputs
GREEN_PB · I.DATA.2BLACK_PB · I.DATA.3RED_PB · I.DATA.1PROXIMITY · I.DATA.10
// outputs + sequencers
L-GREEN · O.DATA.2L-AMBER · O.DATA.1L-RED · O.DATA.0R-GREEN · O.DATA.5R-AMBER · O.DATA.4R-RED · O.DATA.3SQO_L / SQO_RT1 2000ms · T2 2000ms
SQO sequencerSelf-resetting timerACC bit-examinationXOR hazard toggleMutual exclusionSide-switching
Result: Both side sequences step correctly at 2 s. Mutual exclusion confirmed. Hazard ≈2 Hz via T2.ACC.10 technique. All grad constraints met.
